65: static size_t psram_probe_capacity(void)
66: {
67:   volatile uint32_t *base = (volatile uint32_t *)BK7258_PSRAM_BASE;
68:   volatile uint32_t *boundary4 =
69:     (volatile uint32_t *)(BK7258_PSRAM_BASE + 0x00400000u);
70:   volatile uint32_t *boundary8 =
71:     (volatile uint32_t *)(BK7258_PSRAM_BASE + 0x00800000u);
72:   const uint32_t pattern_a = 0xa5a50001u;
73:   const uint32_t pattern_b = 0x5a5a0002u;
74:   uint32_t saved0;
75:   uint32_t saved4;
76:   uint32_t saved8;
77:   size_t capacity = BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE;
78: 
79:   /* Smaller devices wrap their memory window at the physical capacity.
80:    * Save every location before testing so the probe does not corrupt data
81:    * retained by CP or a previous AP generation.
82:    */
83: 
84:   saved0 = *base;
85:   saved4 = *boundary4;
86:   saved8 = *boundary8;
87: 
88:   *base = pattern_a;
89:   *boundary4 = pattern_b;
90:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
91:   if (*base == pattern_b)
92:     {
93:       capacity = 0x00400000u;
94:       goto restore;
95:     }
96: 
97:   *boundary4 = saved4;
98:   *base = pattern_a;
99:   *boundary8 = pattern_b;
100:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
101:   if (*base == pattern_b)
102:     {
103:       capacity = 0x00800000u;
104:     }
105: 
106: restore:
107:   *boundary8 = saved8;
108:   *boundary4 = saved4;
109:   *base = saved0;
110:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
111:   return capacity;
112: }
